name: Flickr Pro
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Flickr Pro, host a personal photo gallery and metadata archive on user-owned storage. The hard boundary is large photography community, discovery, hosting, moderation, and mobile apps, plus image pipeline quality, models, and workflow polish.
